notes.title: DarKnot | Early Access Release
notes.notes:
Today DarKnot goes into early access and we hope that you will appreciate our project and get the most out of the game.

We have written for you this easy-to-follow instruction on the use of weapons, tools, and consumables in order to make it easier for you to defend yourself and survive in this nightmare.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/4c66687b6f5c7bf25d1f3f7028b15282aa80625f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/eb42fe4a17ba2b8b08a1b7f69eeb748cb89c6374.png[/img]

A character can carry three weapons and two tools. Usually the main character picks up the tools with his left hand, and the weapons with his right one.

"1" — tool selection (the left hand)
"2" — weapon selection (the right hand).
"3" and "4" — consumables selection (the left hand).

The consumables (first-aid kits, candles, ammo, etc.) do not take up space in the main character's inventory. Some consumables should be shifted to the left hand in order to use them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/563a71fd9877aac4d809229f37e4844640e2089e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/51a62f56f423c8b93ef40d6fe156bd9bf1847d95.png[/img]

To take a tool that, for example, hangs on a belt, you must press the "1" key.
To select a consumable item, the player needs to press "3" or "4."

Since the character can have a lot of these items on him, two keys are used to select the next or previous item.

The "2" key is used to go through weapons. The character can only carry two weapons on him, not counting the one he has in his right hand.

If the player tries to pick up an item in his hand that already holds something, then this item will move to any suitable slot on the character (for example, on the back or belt). If there are no free slots for this item but the player wants to pick it up, then the main character will throw away the item that he held in his hand before.

See you in co-op mode,

notes.title: DarKnot | Devlog - November
notes.notes:
[b]Pig or horse?[/b]

We know that you are ashamed to be a man in these parts, and you are trying to look like locals. You don't want to get punched in the face in combat and completely lose your eyesight. And, for sure, you have not yet mastered the ritual with the transformation into a monster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/ee694df2b50beaa972eadc9414f8e412dc926157.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/6ce50d7bb3ab14b6331b0a77fc4459cb5309b4f0.jpg[/img]

That’s why we have added masks and animal skulls - this is our gift to you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/fd4f6fce206b15b5c0aa642ebeeaf909cc78d71e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/b224127b1b88a838afd32a1a21244a633272e95e.jpg[/img]

They will help you to not feel like a stranger on these streets, protect your healthy eye from blows, and spare your head that is already suffering from severe disorders, of all unnecessary information.

We plan to add more masks and skulls in the future, and if you have any mask ideas you want to use in DarKnot, we'd love to hear about them! Share your ideas in the discussion [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1371560/discussions]here.[/url]

[b]Sound Design and Music[/b]

The game music is consistent in terms of tempo used (70 bpm) and the key (most of the parts are in the key of E or G).

The music cues used in the game (e.g. the menu) and communication tools such as trailers and teasers use the same combinations of musical instruments such as a detuned zitherette. This gives DarKnot its unique voice.

[previewyoutube=KJSV3M8XGW0;full][/previewyoutube]

The game ambiences were created with field recordings from the abandoned locations similar to the locations used in the game (e.g. an abandoned psychiatric hospital, an old coal mine, the abandoned city neighborhoods).

Several talented singers provided their voices for recording vocalizations for the NPCs.

[b]New Chess Pieces[/b]

Standard chess pieces turned out to be too simple for this world and left it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/f6d4ff74f5c0a8cd11619f27f94e91144ef832f8.png[/img]

They were replaced by mystical figures with human faces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/1dc6ee825d92aadc47feaa8570ea1c2648c5c962.png[/img]

Light figures are very frightened by something. They obviously know something about this world that you don't know yet...

[b]Local Laws[/b]

In DarKnot you have to learn the laws of this gloomy world and connect the events taking place in the past with your present.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/170ce2a21d249ee398a28af3c68eb83a1f5e2872.png[/img]

You will fight against various factions of monsters, and later you will need to share your knowledge of the world with another MPC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/5fe9c589644fbe916e34adf03619ed64d1f1a101.png[/img]

[b]Very soon![/b]

November 3rd DarKnot goes into early access. In early access, you will find the  co-op mode and access to several cities with an open world simulation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/642b1e27a92297dcdddc591a93f9d075f21e616f.png[/img]

The cities of DarKnot are full of unexpected encounters and events that will never stop to amaze you. You will never guess who or what is waiting for you as the game progresses.

You can play the game the way you want, according to your ‘modus vivendi’, so to speak:

As a Warrior, if you like to pick a fight. Gather weapons, and set out to destroy your enemies.

As an Explorer, search for hidden objects, avoid fights, and meticulously explore the gloomy locations and lore of DarKnot.

As a Survivor, gather resources, craft items, and pick your fights wisely. Crafted weapons and explosives will help overcome enemies, but are costly.

Or as a Fugitive, scared and paranoid, avoid the monsters, and cover your tracks. Using tarot cards will help you stay unnoticed, but it will cost you your health and sanity.

If you haven't already, make sure to wishlist DarKnot on Steam here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1371560/DarKnot/

Wearing the pig masks,
[b]DarKnot Team[/b]

notes.title: DarKnot Horror Game Stream
notes.notes:
DarKnot is a non-linear psychological horror game experience, focusing on a high level of detail and immersion. Here you will find insidious opponents, dynamic battles and puzzles of various degrees of difficulty. It's up to you to decide in what style to play the game.

It was inspired by our favorite horror games: Silent Hill, Resident Evil, The Evil Within, Dead by Deadlight and The Last of Us.

The early access version of the game is scheduled to be released this fall.

The game is a combination of survival horror, adventure, and roguelike. The MPC wakes up in a safe place, gets ready for a sortie, thinks over their strategy, prepares their inventory items, and makes a sortie. The player will then find new items and solve puzzles leading to new locations with other safe places. When the MPC dies and wakes up, they will either be in the safe place they previously woke up in, or a new one if they made progress. Then the loop starts over.

You can play DarKnot according to your ‘modus vivendi,’ so to speak. If you like to pick a fight, you accumulate as many weapons as you’re able to, and set out to destroy your enemies. This way, you play as a **warrior**.

On the other hand, you can meticulously explore the gloomy locations and search for the hidden objects. In this case, you play as an **explorer**—no need to get weapons for you!

If you’re a **fugitive** who is paranoid about scary monsters following your track, you can use a tarot card and remove all your traces—but this comes at the price of lowering your stamina or health points. 

If you are a **survivor**, you gather as many items as possible and craft anything, and everything! Often you don’t enter fights, but if you do you use all your crafted weapons and resources such as explosives to overcome an enemy.

You can solve puzzles in a traditional way by looking for clues, but you can also lose your temper and break stuff instead, just like in real life. You build relationships with different game factions in your own manner—make them allies, or enemies.

notes.title: DarKnot Devlog | September - Part 3
notes.notes:
[b]Bad behavior[/b]

Watch the creatures of the DarKnot world -- sometimes they are calm and just lead a miserable existence. At such moments, you can get to know their lifestyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/8a942a1334bbc1a6359168063490727a251d1c4c.png[/img]

Depending on the creature's type and their level of aggression, it decides for itself what to do when strangers are detected. Just like you, creatures can choose to fight, hide, or run away.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/3850f0ef6025f0e8fba864fec7a6aa0804b00d5f.png[/img]

But do not rush to celebrate the victory if they ran away from you. Their flight doesn't mean that they will disappear forever. Perhaps the cowardly creatures will go for help and will soon come back to you with a crowd of their counterparts. It's going to be much worse if they complain about you to someone much more dangerous than themselves...

[b]Craft[/b]

Create the necessary items and repair the broken ones. Turn on your imagination and use the same item for different purposes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/208ca293c6535caa92bd5653d6442fded84c959f.png[/img]

For example, with a saw, you can saw off the revolver's barrel with a stuck bullet, or screws that prevent you from getting a quest item. Or you can cut off the enemy's head. Just remember to not drop the saw, otherwise your enemy will be able to pick it up and then they will saw off your head instead.

[b]The Savages[/b]

If something sharp pierces the Savage's body, it is not fatal to them. You can shoot one of them right in the heart, but it won't kill the Savage. They look like people, but inside there is nothing human left.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/b2ac784a8d40733f7ef1a7b37d4e7af24a32e52d.png[/img]

The Savages are cannibals, always hungry and weak. Degraded and mentally ill, they will eat you alive.

[b]Another nightmare...[/b]

Do you feel like you are in a desperate situation?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/fba10964bbb92919feabd34db4c6cee0a4307f98.png[/img]

Do you feel a sense of loss, guilt, hopelessness and uselessness in this world? If you want to put an end to this, get a wire and hang youself, but it won’t work. Even if it does, you will still wake up. And this nightmare again...

Will return to you soon,
[b]DarKnot Team[/b]

notes.title: DarKnot Devlog | September - Part 2
notes.notes:
Today we will talk about the weather, the diary, early access and the cardboard virus.

[b]Weather and time of day[/b]

In the world of DarKnot, weather and time of day operate according to unknown laws. Are they controlled by someone or something?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/c1851cbbd846859177d37eb415b326ac404c4076.png[/img]

How do the time and the weather react to the game events?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/8783a061b4b13bc6b8ec9ba94274d559e656f287.png[/img]

The answers are not found yet. But, as everyone knows, thick fog and darkness are filled with many dangers ...

[b]The diary? This is what you need![/b]

It's not uncommon for players to start by looking for clues in the diary -- they're doing absolutely the right thing. In the diary, you can check your vital signs, find out information about enemies and find clues on what to do and where to go next. The diary will always be with you, it will help you find answers to many questions. You can also find tarot cards in it or, for example, learn how to create explosives.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/3a44044b4549f32b8f0245a17ddaef6b2c4315af.png[/img]

As you progress, you will insert the pages you find into the diary, and you will be able to better understand the intricate history of the dark world of DarKnot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/9c93b1b5e14f507524f736f2f7a82211a9e67148.png[/img]

[b]Early Access[/b]

DarKnot is still in development and we plan to go into early access later this year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/9bac5d60a4d20fb4d861434b88e93b2c0e6ac181.png[/img]

In early access, more locations will be available. We will optimize the game and fix all possible bugs. We also plan to add localization for German, Japanese, French, Italian, Spanish and Portuguese.

[b]Where has all the cardboard gone?[/b]

And finally, let's talk about the most important thing.

Many people believe that cardboard boxes are only good for sleeping in or for using them as coffins for the burial of allied insects who fell in battle. But you can make a lot of useful and interesting things out of cardboard. For example, cardboard zombies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/5e2b9f2c343c311fc6f2301bbe324d63475a5ba9.png[/img]

Now cardboard will take revenge on everyone who did not respect it. Perhaps it will infect opponents with a Cardboard Virus (aka CardVID) or even bite them to death. The vaccinated individuals need not worry, but just in case, wear masks in places with a large gathering of cardboard creatures.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1371560/DarKnot/

With love,
Cardboard Virus Department 
of the [b]DarKnot Team[/b]

notes.title: DarKnot | DevLog - September
notes.notes:
The sun is almost invisible here, and it is difficult to breathe. Unpleasant odors and strange sounds are around every corner. The very description of these places can cause discomfort, not to mention visiting them.

But the DarKnot neighborhoods won't explore themselves!

[previewyoutube=CUE5UNQN120;full][/previewyoutube]

Garbage underfoot and the corpses of strange creatures on the ground. Buildings that have collapsed, leaving the shattered glass on the roads and piercing the soles of your boots. The surroundings have probably experienced a lot, and once life was in full swing here. But this is in the past, and now the cities are gradually being eaten by the closing darkness.

Left and abandoned places in the cities of DarKnot evoke fear and anxiety. They have no friends, no life. And don't kid yourself—those you meet in the city are not alive. But when and why were these cities abandoned by their peaceful inhabitants? So far, there are more questions than answers. Try to figure out what's going on.

[b]Save Place[/b]
 
After lying dead for a day, and sometimes for several days, the main character awakens on his own. We have to admit that after that, he can stink. Most often, you will come to life sitting on a torn old chair, if you have already found it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/175889b9d323417690563a81f89556642c0a87a6.png[/img]

If you didn’t find it, you will wake up where the developers want you to. =)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/da217fc04363dc57dd01884b668ed4f1589c448c.png[/img]
 
Apart from this chair and a couple of rotten tables, you will have almost nothing at the beginning of the game. But as you progress, you will find many items that improve your living conditions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/a9527e1cd9cf88ff7c535e71000ef5722bf75fd6.png[/img]

You will find out later how useful these things are.
 
[b]The fight? Maybe you don't need it.[/b]
 
Do you want to fight like this? Have a look at yourself—do you think you can put up a worthy resistance to your enemies? I am wounded, slow and hungry after long weeks or months in this place. Or maybe you've been here for several years, and only the locals know what they drugged you with and what they did to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/0e44b0e6da4a22af3e020ea8f7b5b83fa3abf56c.png[/img]

Perhaps some sadistic surgeons removed several organs from you and clogged that toilet next to the bleeding chessboard...

[previewyoutube=xvyz5-WAmMM;full][/previewyoutube]

If so, that explains the innumerable scars on your body as well as your physical and mental weakness. Therefore, the next time you come across your enemies, think about what action would be best to take – fight, hide, or flee and survive...

[b]The Savage King[/b]
 
In the city, we have added the King of the Savage faction and quests with him.
 
There is no one in NIGHTMARE who loves himself more than this king. He is really selfish and takes great care of himself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/1db20ab2477386dfcfff40f69dfb8b775c158252.png[/img]

This king is a cunning bastard, and he takes his place for a reason. If you help him, perhaps he will help you in the future (or maybe he won't). He has lots of servants, although not without traitors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/dc178ae3dc2f6866335c6270e34c74d9ebb6fecc.png[/img]

On the other hand, he does not inspire confidence; he seems to destroy anyone as soon as he's got a chance.
Be sure to add DarKnot to your wishlist. This is the only real support for us.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1371560/DarKnot/?beta=1

Not (yet) turned into savages,
[b]DarKnot Team[/b]

notes.title: DarKnot - Journal Entry - August (Part 2)
notes.notes:
[b]Did you know that DarKnot will have several city locations?[/b]
[b]We decided to dedicate a new dev diary to this topic.[/b]

In cars abandoned by their owners, you can find a lot of useful things.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/01dad48e9edae83feadd4940d7a5d1638c28b7d0.png[/img]

So feel free to break into them – it is unlikely that the owners of the cars will ever return and file a complaint. Therefore, it is necessary to collect medicine, leftover food, look for clues, and somehow get out of this place. Just be sure that you can fight back if the alarm goes off and you have drawn unwanted attention to yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/b575c04ec6fde3ad80251138641a28f763bd8769.png[/img]

Most likely, the owners of the cars are already dead, and for them, this whole nightmare is over. But not for you: you will return again and again. Giving up is not an option.

[b]New faction[/b]

Strange noises and desperate screams are heard in the unlit streets of the world of DarKnot.
You will definitely hear them, but only in the darkness. And if you move silently, you can pass by without seeing the appearance of the creatures that make these sounds. But as soon as you make your presence known with an awkward step or the slightest rustle, these strange, sometimes pathetic, frightening creatures will appear from all the cracks.

[previewyoutube=v_rt_gJzOBw;full][/previewyoutube]

They are fast and attack in a pack. Fight or flight, it's up to you. The damage from their blows is not critical, but extremely unpleasant. These creatures run up to you with a wild scream, which, combined with pitch darkness, is quite creepy. After dealing or taking damage, there is a high chance that they will run away, but will soon return to repeat their futile attempts to take out their anger from their powerlessness on you.

[b]Clothing[/b]

In the streets, we threw heaps of clothes on the dusty roads.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/bd9ed70091da733656d062cb577663d392a096ea.png[/img]

Wearing these clothes is not a pleasure for everyone. But this is better than running around the city in shorts, freezing and shocking your enemies with outrageous behavior. All found items of clothing are now transferred to the locker next to the chair, where you are resurrected after each death. After the resurrection, you may have a question: what stinks more - the clothes found in the street or the main character? We will have time to find out if you lived more than once.

[b]Screen brightness[/b]

Our team watched more than a hundred streams of the closed DarKnot demo and found out that very few people discovered a little secret. It is hidden in the screen brightness bar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/64177b13f5d184b8bc184cc5bcb5c87f140a927f.gif[/img]

In situations where pitch darkness comes suddenly, when the fuses are blown by the thunderstorm, and there are no light sources nearby, remember the brightness settings. They can help you, but we cannot fully guarantee that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/c371faeb2d953dd3e20dd76c5c7a189fae7183bf.png[/img]


[b]Add DarKnot to your wishlist to be the first to know when the game enters Early Access:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1371560/DarKnot/?beta=1

Now we are struggling to get DarKnot ready for early access and are working on new locations. We are also optimizing the game, fixing the voice acting, and eliminating all possible bugs.
If you encounter bugs, please send them to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1371560/discussions/]Feedback and Bugs[/url] in the discussions on Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/757c4f01400c5f4ebe19e285172ee9015f958338.gif[/img]

By finding bugs and reporting them, you help us a lot!

We would like to express our deep gratitude to the voice actor Brian Watts. He recorded the voice over of one of our MPCs for the Rituals part of DarKnot, and we cannot recommend him more. Not only does Brian make the effort to breathe life into the character, he does so with great passion. We received a lot of positive feedback on his voice acting. You can hear his part in the free demo available on Steam. 

[previewyoutube=evCZkONXusQ;full][/previewyoutube]

If any of our colleagues from other gamedev studios need his services, here is his [url=https://brianwattsva.com/][b]web site[/b][/url] with a demo reel and portfolio.


Infected by Nightmare

notes.title: DarKnot - Journal Entry #3 - Part 2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/517ba130ea2e398f3fbe15e3f2ea53136d944de7.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

The DarKnot Team is back with a second part to our June Journal Entry as promised!

Today we’ll focus on more changes made to our exclusive alpha build, but you can still check out our public demo, available on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1371560/DarKnot/]Steam here[/url].

So, without further ado, let’s jump right in!

[h2]The Park[/h2]
One of the main changes in The Park was the introduction of a brand new character, the ever sinister and foreboding Crow!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/b4013cb94fe7cf08b00695c56dcee83f93f2952a.png[/img]

The crows addition comes with a lot of flavor, and small interactions with the player. We added the perfect ambiance from a cold winter night, and you’ll get to hear more crows in the background - friends, or foes?

Our new winged friends will periodically gather at The Park, and it would be wise for the player to avoid them; if you get too close they will cackle and fly away, alerting the entire district of your presence there. Watch your step!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/b5fbc735d67efe5833071ae1eba6df91c7b4b19a.png[/img]

A bit sneakier than their real life counterparts, The Park’s crows will be a constant worry for the player, and come for their items. If they are successful, they will steal items from the player’s inventory, and take away a nice chunk of health as well. 

But don’t worry, the crows aren’t just here to make your day miserable. Not only can you fight back and throw objects at them, but they’re also the only way to access the key to progress DarKnot’s story. No spoilers however!

While exploring the area, you can find the Crow’s Nest, where you might find a defunct specimen, and also a Trash Cannon! You can use it on garbage cans, turning them into a deadly stationary weapon. Why would such a powerful weapon be hiding here?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/25df1e532b66abe32fe8ef3b045cd54a84425f57.png[/img]

But that’s not everything for The Park! Our team has significantly enhanced the area, adding more encounters and polishing the ambiance. 

Upon starting the level, the player wakes up on a bench in The Park, a candle burning in their hand, weakly illuminating the impenetrable darkness. The following cutscene has been added, focusing on the player getting up and trying to assess their surroundings. 

Another cutscene about the Cultist Party Van’s exit, and the player’s possible death scene has also been added.

The sound has been reworked, adding various noises to the environment:
[list][*] Whispers of the cultists
[*] Shouts of the cultists
[*] Rumbling sound of a cage[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/09217ae6329d915b1863a6ac9be9ad834985c7a2.png[/img]

The Park also received more foes - a pack of wandering stray dogs has been added. It’s best that you don’t try to feed them!

A bell was added in The Park, and the player can interact with it at the gates. Be careful not to alert the surrounding enemies!

[h2]The Rituals[/h2]
The Rituals, available in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1371560/DarKnot/]free Demo[/url], received a nice overhaul in our Exclusive Alpha Build as well. But before, we expanded the Tarot cards available to the player:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/43c5a7397ceb3bad5c2c7d724fb30d65541d7419.png[/img]

[list]
[*] The Blindness card has been added, granting the player 25% more stealth upon their awakening
[*] The Pretender card has been added, granting a candle on the table upon awakening[/list]
Our artists have been hard at work, creating numerous new icons and UI pieces to make the DarKnot experience a whole lot smoother:
[list][*] Added new damage and durability icons
[*] Added an icon with a finger on the control buttons for small objects (radio buttons, etc.)
[*] Added an icon with a slightly bent finger for rotation[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/0d821326d1d89101e09c86eb04fa828ad5888d3b.png[/img]

A lot of items received an inspection screen, providing you with more details about what happened in The Ritual Room:
[list][*] Added an inspection screen for the armored lock after the player breaks it
[*] Added an inspection screen for the insect
[*] Added an inspection screen for the Cthulhu Box[/list]We also have some small changes, and miscellaneous items: 
[list][*] Added a note about a candle and possible damage from getting too close to a candle
[*] Spider webs will trap the player, but can now be burnt down by candles
[*] In the Ritual room, footstep sounds are now synchronized with animations
[*] The Mancinell faction now has proper sounds and health bars
[*] When reloading a gun, the items that were in your hands will conceal properly
[*] Improved brightness settings[/list]
And that’s it for June everyone! This Journal Entry was a big one and we hope you liked it! If you want more, make sure to join us on [url=https://discord.gg/VyvQwJ7VUU]Discord[/url] for more sneak peeks at what we’re working on!

Signing off,

DarKnot Team

notes.title: DarKnot - Developer Journal Entry #3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/997751b539c9ce9f916f8c6312ccddf171ad9a37.png[/img]

Hey everyone, DarKnot Team here with another Developer Journal Entry for you!

This month the team heavily focused on reworking different game locations and levels, while getting ready for Early Access. As this month has been very busy for us, we’ve decided to split the Journal Entry in two parts: The first half now, and the rest in two weeks. Stay tuned! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/a097fd173e203313ebee6d34c3865d1b86b21988.png[/img]

[h3]The Apartment[/h3]
One of the most interesting places of our exclusive Alpha Build, the Apartment has received a substantial update and a lot of new mechanics. You’ll be able to see them for yourself in our next Closed Alpha, keep an eye out for it! In the meantime, here’s what we’ve been working on for this location.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/eeb0c02fda170163d27e5fa7fd49fd57dc35ae02.png[/img]

To make the apartment more lively (and definitely not to lure the player into a false sense of security), we filled the place with interactive cabinets and drawers, and added a lot of common, day-to-day objects. Most of them won’t be of any use really, but you can always take your frustration out on those and throw them across the room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/fe00773bc8f7f67746024973b9799fbc71a434fc.png[/img]

We have made some changes to the child in the apartment, and tweaked their behavior a little bit - now making the encounter even creepier than before.

The apartment has been filled with the child’s drawings, further highlighting the deteriorating mental state of the kid. Their in-game behavior was also improved: They will begin talking to the player as soon as the study is opened, and linger longer in the father’s room when roaming the apartment, as they naturally miss their papa.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/64e2af484a92df5fdd949a984d04e451fd441189.png[/img]

On top of the AI improvements, the audio for the child has been improved: The child attacks will have proper sounds, and we also made them less talkative overall. However, the apartment will be filled with their sighs and whimpers while they are asleep.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/6611fdb044b7065d4b139d6a97b3fdd9c9e09244.png[/img]

The apartment’s bathroom is now… inhabited by a spirit that will take the player for a spin, should they enter the room uninvited. Jumpscares, bloody hands on the sink’s glass, mysterious footsteps… The ghost will use every trick in the book to force the player out of their room.

Anger has also received their signature sounds, and you’ll have the joy of hearing the screams of those who were burned alive... Come prepared! We also added the sounds of heartbeats and heavy breathing at the sight of the ghost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/3782b241a28c2f7905c2800fc60e7b781fe2dea0.png[/img]

The cultist also received some love from the dev team, they will now spawn closer to the door, giving you a good opportunity to get a close look at them, before they send you flying through the door. Speaking of which, we have reworked the cutscene, added the sounds of the body falling and hitting the floor, as well as some expected swearing from the player’s character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/ae1786c2e05975afa5b7de0b58742af302e1ae0a.png[/img]

A lot of time was spent adding, modifying, and polishing the details of our terrifying world and doing our best to make your experience in DarKnot a lot more immersive. Some of those changes are listed below:

[h3]Additions:[/h3]
[list][*] Added the ability for NPCs to aim down (they were limited to a horizontal point of aime previously).
[*] Added voice acting for the cutscene after the ritual completion.
[*] Added an inspection of the fallen frame.
[*] Added the live camera effect and the open window effect.
[*] Added sounds for doors - clicking the door handle, slamming it shut, and creaking when opening.
[*] Added physics: the doors now are interactive.
[*] Added the sound of burning paper notes.
[*] Added more hints to the book describing the “Ritual of Immersion”.
[*] Added sound to candles.
[*] Sound occlusion has been added when the windows are closed.
[*] Tuned the attenuation: when approaching an open window, the sounds of the thunderstorm increase.[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list][*] The awakening cutscene has been fixed.
[*] Worked out animations for the cultist's hands.
[*] Fixed errors in the ritual description’s text on the table.
[*] Fixed the sitting animations for the child.[/list]

[h3]Misc:[/h3]
[list][*] The office’s key description is now available.
[*] Added the Witch's Brushwood description.
[*] Worked out a complete list of options for the title screen.
[*] A log list is now available for saves.
[*] Newspaper fonts have been improved.
[*] Added an “Open palm” icon on doors and large objects the player can lift.
[*] Improved the doors and drawers in the study, now they open more smoothly.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/57c9240ac8b18c659438fc1d707c644d31590673.png[/img]

And that’s the first part of our dev log for this month! Part 2 will be available very soon, with even more exciting changes. Stay tuned, and tell us your thoughts on [url=https://discord.gg/VyvQwJ7VUU]Discord[/url]! 

Signing off,
DarKnot Team

notes.title: DarKnot - Developer Journal Entry #2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/cef1b7182cea786b893b26b8129b495be5270fab.png[/img]

Hello everyone! DarKnot Team here, back with another Journal Entry!

These few months have been spent taking a deep dive into some of our games’ objects and mechanics, as well as a brand new Diary UI and ambient sounds! So hold onto that flashlight as we take you through some of our adrenaline-inducing changes.

[h3]NEW DIARY UI[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/2ab65ef38442b3fb1dd2295408fd61537e2b24d8.png[/img]

Your only companion in the streets of DarKnot, the diary got some QOL changes and improvements, starting by the addition of a page turning animation while scrolling down the elements, not to mention the improvement of its general operation and usability in-game. 

Read through new notes about DarKnot’s lore too, and to educate yourself about the Cult, the Ghosts, and other morbid entities roaming the world. You can find these notes in safe places, or from a certain “friend”, who will describe some of his experiences in the Nightmare world….

[h2]NEW BURNER MECHANIC[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/5b64aa51fab2a8916c985557ca5f4150d8563703.png[/img]

We’re turning up the heat with our new burner mechanic, that you can find and use against your foes! The flames deal heavy damage to your enemies, but the fuel supply is limited. Spend it wisely…

[h2]MORE EFFECTS AND ATMOSPHERE[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/07b09b6f2313f8a55be4287b60963db2601bc83e.png[/img]

Our Catacombs have been reworked to include new hair-raising sounds, as well as the addition of ghosts locked up behind the stone wall. Remember to always be on your guard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/2e71d91d70ccdf675cf5a22bd34b7089d792dbae.png[/img]

The Nightmare World also received a ghoulish upgrade - the Ghost will now be a more frequent encounter, and he will be able to summon his “brothers” to attack you from the same walls of these gloomy and decrepit corridors. Be wary though; they have learned to attack you from a distance, while the formidable boss Ghost became much stronger as well! You’ll have to think through every step to survive. 

[previewyoutube=w84O1iZ0LgQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We’ve also turned the fear factor up on the Catacombs’ sound effects and music, adding distinct and terrifying sounds each time a ghost’s hand appears from the walls. On your way to the cell of the escapee too, we’ve added even more sinister sounds and effects.

And it’s worth noting, that dark corners may not be safe to hide in anymore either, as the ghosts of the Nightmare world are said to roam the unlit areas of the catacombs…

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS AND ADDITIONS[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/aa42c5015581fa8fd63257c30c6d396941015970.jpg[/img]

The Champion just became EVEN. MORE. DANGEROUS.

This three-meter monster now attacks faster. Oh and if you do not keep your distance from him, you might catch a huge gear to the head! While his throwing is good, his ax-wielding skills are unmatched, and a full magazine will not be enough to bring him down. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/fb1730017987ac4ce5bbf6f59b23fb3ac91126e8.png[/img]

But don’t worry! We’ve also added more weapons. Try your hands at our new machetes and swords that can be taken from the Cultists you killed. Cut, slash and force your way through with ease, as seen in our previous [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1371560/view/3124940160293993056]Journal Entry[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/9debcbb5198931926b1756af4311452e274606b1.png[/img]

Many of our items can be interacted with too, when in first person mode! Simply pick up, turn, and throw to your heart’s content. Don’t litter, however…you never know who’s watching you.

[h2]BUG FIXES AND MISCELLANEOUS[/h2]

[list][*] Improved NPC behavior in the game.
[*] Improved visuals in the level design.
[*] Improved, fixed and added animations.
[*] Improved cutscenes in the game (improved player viewing angles and added missing sounds).
[*] Added more in-game art and item icons to almost all interaction items. Also added the child's drawings that the MPC will find in the future.
[*] Added another crafting recipe for an energy bar to the Demo. It prevents the MPC from dying of hunger.
[*] Bots do not attack through walls; their intelligence and behavior has been improved. 
[*] Fixed the positions of objects in the character's hands.
[*] Adjusted the in-game camera. [/list]

Now go recover from this adrenaline-raising Journal Entry! And be sure to join us on [url=https://discord.gg/VyvQwJ7VUU]Discord[/url] for more teasers every week and to meet more DarKnot fans. The Champion will know if you don’t…

Signing off,

DarKnot Team

notes.title: DarKnot - Developer Journal Entry #1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/952d6a6e8a6bb8228a8cb147013376b30be4aa91.png[/img]

Welcome everyone, to our first Journal Entry of our new development cycle! Here at Elbrus Lab, we want to make sure you get those updates regularly moving forward, and we’re super happy to show off some of the latest features we’ve been working on!

Without further ado, let’s jump right in!

[h2]Cultist Weapons[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/fb1730017987ac4ce5bbf6f59b23fb3ac91126e8.png[/img]

We have made our cultists much more deadly by giving them their own weapons! Blunt weapons, 1887 Winchesters, double barrel shotguns, and much more. Our new armed Cultists will be tough opponents to fight, and you will have to stay on your toes to survive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/369b98ab2416246bc806506eea45fca056dfd088.png[/img]

One of the most iconic weapons we added is a custom Mauser C96 Pistol. We chose this firearm as it perfectly describes the organization it’s serving. It’s Archaic and conservative, with fundations going back to decades before, but also technologically sound and stylish, adapted to the needs of the Cult. The perfect fit for a creepy secret society, and its creepy secret affairs.

We have also given the MPC the ability to disarm the cultists, and take the weapons as their own. While dangerous, it’ll give you a fighting chance!

[h2]Torn Clothes[/h2]

We wanted to make sure decisions and events had a visual effect on the MPC, so we have now made it possible to tear the MPC’s clothing! After a tough fight, damage from the environment, or following a cutscene, your character's clothes will show signs of wear and tear. We feel it really adds personality to the playthrough, and allows the players to see the troubles the MPC has had to face more realistically.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/c86a6f2e2ee425dddf3cfa2051e8296a742cd8b2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/f54756c133ca73c9cc5e711d9d9a1abee1c35404.png[/img]

[h2]Level Design[/h2]

We reworked the rooms and infrastructure leading out of the “Fight Club”, a place where some scientific experiment went awry. We expanded the subway station where the Ancient Cult set up its subterranean headquarters, and the player's path will lead to another victim of DarKnot. It is still impossible to understand what happened there, as we can only visit the containment room, look at the terrible scene, and read about what kind of experiments this “experiment” went through.

In the depths of the corridors you will be able to find escapees of those experiments, and only an acute explorer will be able to uncover the secret of this entire faction.

[h2]Knock Knock[/h2]

Prepare yourselves, the enemies can now open doors…how will you adapt and survive with this game-changing feature? Point of advice - nowhere is ever really “safe”.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ejo0e24.gif[/img]

[h2]New Effects[/h2]

After receiving community feedback, and learning how to improve our SFX, we have been working hard on improving the visuals and effects in different areas of the game. A notable one is in the Ritual Room, where the locks will appear red hot and melt away when unlocked. We won’t tell you where the keys are or how to open it however.. You’ll have to figure it out yourself! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vGd9Yvb.gif[/img]

[h2]Quality of Life Improvement[/h2]

Having to re-collect recipes after each death was pretty tedious for players in the current demo, and to be fair, everyone hates it when you have to go hunt for pages or information you already had before dying.. It’s even more true in a game like DarKnot where dying is part of the experience. So we made it so recipes are now stored in your journal, and you won’t need to collect them again after dying!


That’s it for our first Journal Entry for this development cycle! We hope you’re as excited as we are for all the new improvements to the game. Make sure to join fellow DarKnot survivors on [url=https://twitter.com/DarknotGame]Twitter[/url], [url=www.facebook.com/DarKnot-109649844978100]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/darknotgame/?igshid=1fs0b9ud1yvje]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/VyvQwJ7VUU]Discord[/url], and don’t forget to download our Demo. Stay tuned for the second entry next month!

Signed, 
DarKnot Team

notes.title: Developer's Diary #3
notes.notes:
Now the character and the player will be able to find a new set: a plaid shirt and dark pants.  One of the mechanics of the game is associated with clothes, that's why you will get almost none at the very beginning. Instead, you'll be running around the location and getting dirty. Dirty clothes become an excellent "beacon" for opponents with a keen sense of smell.  Dogs, insects and Jojo can smell you a mile away. To attract less attention, you need to find new clothes or clean yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/9f1542bc4f0e902de051ff47488de6cf1ed93508.png[/img]

It will not be easy to find the plaid shirt in the build: in DarKnot, all resources that increase the chances of survival must be found, created or obtained otherwise.

notes.title: DevDiary #2
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

Here is the second DevDiary post. Today we’ll go to Endspring, or the Fourth City where events of our game DarKnot are unfolding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/1992699a63a11abf61f000c91ab0670510a5e137.png[/img]

Winding streets, bleak yards, dark pathways of the city park… All these places used to be lively but now they’re sunk into the nightmare and turned into a deadly labyrinth for the occasional travellers. It’s very easy to get into the Fourth City but in order to survive and get out of it one has to look into the darkness, make sense of what’s going on and find the way out. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41007250/45a444f99a8e963683e223ef287bf0c48d6ad8c6.png[/img]

We’ve been preparing dangerous adventures for the release but now we’d like to show you several concepts. Some events may look familiar to you since you played the build and watched the teaser, some of them will be the spoilers of the underground city we enter after roaming in the catacombs.
